name: Hernia surgery
summary: How expats evaluate hernia repair in Singapore — inguinal, umbilical, and incisional pathways, open vs laparoscopic options, and return-to-work timing for desk vs physical roles.
body:
Hernias often show up as a groin bulge after lifting, gym strain, or postpartum wall weakness. Surgery is usually definitive; trusses are bridging tools, not cures. General surgery clinics manage assessment, imaging when needed, and repair planning.

## Common types
- Inguinal / femoral
- Umbilical / paraumbilical
- Incisional (post prior surgery)
- Sportsman hernia evaluations (diagnosis contested — get a careful exam)

Emergency incarceration/strangulation symptoms (irreducible painful bulge, vomiting) need A&E, not elective clinic queues.

## Technique and recovery
Open and minimally invasive approaches each have mesh and recovery trade-offs. Ask about recurrence rates, nerve-pain risk, and when you can lift groceries, kids, or gym loads again. Desk workers often return sooner than warehouse or healthcare movers.

## How to choose
Prefer surgeons who examine standing and supine, explain watchful waiting criteria for small asymptomatic hernias, and give written activity timelines. Insurance pre-auth is common for elective repair — get diagnostic wording exact.

## Practical tip
Photograph the bulge when it appears later in the day; it may reduce in clinic mornings. Stop heavy deadlifts until cleared — ego lifting before repair worsens tissue.
